legal.fullDisclaimerBody:
ArnonaCut is an educational planning tool about municipal property charges (“arnona”). All outputs—including illustrative percentage ranges, breakdowns, checklists, and downloadable PDFs or ZIP packs—are provided for general orientation only. They are not official assessments, quotations, or binding calculations and may be incomplete, outdated, or unsuitable for your specific facts.

The numbers shown are estimates only. They do not predict any actual discount, rebate, exemption, refund, approval timeline, or final liability.

Nothing on this website, in any message, or inside any generated document constitutes legal advice, tax advice, accounting advice, or guidance from any government body. Using ArnonaCut does not create an attorney–client relationship or any other regulated professional relationship. Obtain advice from a qualified professional before relying on any conclusion here.

Only the competent municipality or other statutory authority may decide whether any reduction applies, what evidence and forms are required, and what deadlines apply. That authority is solely responsible for its final decision on your case. ArnonaCut is not affiliated with any municipality or government entity and does not submit applications on your behalf. Any filing is performed only if you independently prepare and submit materials yourself.

You are fully responsible for every submission you make to any authority, for verifying all facts and figures against primary sources and official municipal notices, for correcting any draft text produced here, and for meeting all procedural and time limits. You accept that any reliance on estimates or templates is at your own risk.

Paid materials remain educational templates and aids. Purchase does not guarantee any particular outcome. Demo or placeholder payment flows are for testing and must be replaced by compliant payment processing in production.

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, ArnonaCut and its operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for any loss of profits, goodwill, data, or opportunities arising out of your use of the service. Total aggregate liability shall not exceed the amount you actually paid for the Preparation Kit in the twelve months before the claim, or zero if unpaid. Where limitations are not enforceable, they apply to the fullest extent allowed.

By continuing to use the site you acknowledge these disclaimers together with the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy linked in the footer. If you do not agree, discontinue use immediately.
